text:
Amelia: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — can leadership clarify timelines for the API / Console / Optimize alignment? I heard rough windows but customers are asking for dates. Main asks: model pinning + rollout UI timeline, Optimize’s quantization suggestion export timeline, and when the streaming+function-calls API is considered GA. Thanks!

Dario: Short answers to unblock comms: model pinning + rollout UI — targeting early Q3 (aiming for 2024-08-15); Optimize integration (console suggestions + one-click apply) — aiming end of Q3 (Sept target) but depends on eval infra work; streaming + function-calls API — proto frozen, expect GA ~6 weeks from now. I’ll publish an RFC with exact cutoff dates and rollback plan. :white_check_mark:

Chris: FYI infra dependency — we need KV cache sharding (CLD-1123) merged before canary routing can land. Current blocker is a perf regression in the sharded path. Short command I ran: ```kubectl logs -l app=kv-cache -c cache | grep shard```. I can pair with the runtime team tomorrow to speed this up.

Sarah: For external comms/marketing, recommend we use month-level windows: "late Aug" for pinning, "Sept" for Optimize. Customers hate hard days unless we're 99% confident.

Lee: On Optimize specifics: the initial rollout will surface suggestions in Console first (non-destructive), then expose an API export (CSV/JSON) and a one-click apply later. We’ll tag models as `quant-safe` in the model registry — building that tagging takes ~2 sprints. Also we need a small eval set for regression alerts before wide apply.

Amelia: Good — can someone drop a 2–3 sentence blurb I can share with the customer success team? Also, what's the rollback story if rollout UI causes latency regressions?

Dario: Rollback plan: rollout UI changes are behind per-org feature flags and we have an auto-fallback that switches to the previous pinned model if p50 latency > configured SLA for 5m consecutive. I’ll add the exact thresholds and monitoring queries to the RFC.

Chris: Putting up an immediate TODO: pair on CLD-1123, measure p99 before/after. If anyone sees the perf regression repro, please ping me in #eng-runtime.

Sarah: Blurb for CS (copy/paste): "We’re planning model pinning + rollout UI in late August, Optimize in September (console-first, API export afterward). We’ll communicate exact GA dates when QA and infra gating are green. Customers on Dedicated will get early access"

Lee: Note — Optimize one-click apply will initially be opt-in per-org and require a short eval run (1–2 hours) before changing production weights.

Amelia: Thanks all. Dario — once the RFC is up, can you @-mention product and CS so they can prep docs and customer comms?

Dario: Yep, RFC will land by EOD tomorrow and I’ll ping product + CS.

deploy-bot: Release window reservation created: canary 2024-08-01 -> 2024-08-07 @eng-release. Link: <https://redwood.internal/releases/1823456789|canary-plan> :spiral_calendar:
